scope: Proposition 10.1 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X0, B0 + M) be a rational generalized terminal pair on a normal globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler threefold, with fixed rational b-line data as in Definition 9.2. Every sequence of small elementary steps in the sense of Section 9 starting from this pair terminates. The contraction bases may vary. Here generalized terminal means generalized klt with all exceptional log discrepancies greater than one.
